snippet.title: Pool Pro 2022 - PlayStation 5 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Use your cue to shoot balls into holes, gain score and stars so you can progress further and unlock more powerfull cues.
Use your skill and intelect to solve the levels, but beware, they get harder as the game goes on.
Collect stars and unlock stronger cues so you can beat harder levels.

Published by Ocean Media
Developed by Inlogic Software
